description: NeuroVue explore-stage UI app. Launched by NeuroFlow with a BIDS/NIfTI dataset, it lets the user review volumes, set clip planes, and record corrections, then persists a correction patch and review state to the session output directory.

bids_dir.description: BIDS dataset to open for review.

volumes.description: Specific NIfTI volumes to open instead of, or in addition to, a dataset.

correction_patch.description: Small JSON artifact describing review-time corrections (clip planes, flags, edits).

review_state.description: Viewer state captured when the user finished review.

block.label: Review in NeuroVue
block.description: Open the dataset for interactive review and correction.

neuroflow/launch.description: NeuroVue reads $NEUROFLOW_SESSION/context.json (inputs.bids_dir / inputs.volumes), and on user save POSTs the patch which the server persists to $NEUROFLOW_OUTPUT_DIR/correction.patch.json plus a provenance line.
